вообще-то.gloss: actually, as a matter of fact

meanings.en: actually, as a matter of fact, for the record
meanings.note: Polite or pointed correction.

examples.text: Меня вообще-то Юля зовут. Вот сахар.
examples.trans: My name is actually Yulia. Here's the sugar.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'you (polite or plural)' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: попасть в гид = get listed in the guide

examples.text: Именно из-за меня нас упомянули в гиде.
examples.trans: It was thanks to me that we got mentioned in the guide.
My restaurant made it into the guide!

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to speak, to say, to talk', paired with 'сказать'.
Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to speak, to say, to talk', paired with 'сказать'.

Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to cook; to prepare', paired with 'приготовить'.

examples.text: Я уже не могу готовить, стирать, убирать. Я хочу на море!
examples.trans: I can't take the cooking, washing and cleaning any more. I want to go to the sea!

meanings.note: 'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks. I'll solve all your problems.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.
It is cheaper to find new people.

examples.text: Дешевле найти новых людей, чем платить этот штраф.
examples.trans: It is cheaper to find new people than to pay this fine.

examples.text: На утреннем рынке свежие овощи всегда стоят дешевле.
examples.trans: At the morning market, fresh vegetables always cost less.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: забирать деньги = to take the money
забирать детей из школы = to pick the kids up from school

examples.trans: I pick the children up from school.

examples.text: А я тебе делаю условный срок. Плюс ты забираешь все деньги Вики.
examples.trans: And I get you a suspended sentence. Plus you take all of Vika's money.

завидовать.gloss: to envy, to be jealous of

meanings.note: + dative = someone or something.

examples.trans: I envy you in a good way.

examples.text: У него было ружьё. Все мальчишки завидовали ему.
examples.trans: He had an air gun. All the boys envied him.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я уже знаю. Мне звонили из мэрии.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I already know. The town hall called me.

meanings.note: + genitive.

examples.text: А трава в мешках сгорела. Из-за вас!

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

examples.text: Вот именно. Но мне сдаваться нельзя.
